name: Wholesale Margin Leak Detector

products.name: Wholesale Margin Leak Detector
products.product: Finds margin leakage from stale price lists, freight, small orders, overrides, rebates, rush handling, and customer-specific terms.
products.problem: Reported gross margin masks order-line leakage that accumulates across thousands of routine transactions.
products.valueProposition: Surfaces the exact customer, item, and rule causing leakage and ranks safe repricing or policy actions.
products.startupCost: Solo MVP: web app, CSV import, managed database, and optional read-only integrations.

products.seoThesis: A narrow site for specialty wholesalers and regional distributors can connect commercial pages, calculators, comparisons, and implementation guides around wholesale distribution margin leakage analytics to the same measurable margin outcome.
